title: Architecture Incubator — Hypothesis Cards and Proof Packets
central_diagnosis: The design space is expanding faster than the evidentiary foundation.
controlling_shift: Priority shifts from inventing to proving.

doctrine_freeze.rule: No new principles unless they solve a missing proof requirement.

must_answer_at_least_one: Which Phase 2 gate does this close?
Which constitutional mechanism depends on it?
exception_gate.if_none: Route to Architecture Incubator as a Hypothesis Card — do not mint a new principle, decision cluster, or public doctrine surface as if publishable.
exception_gate.approval: Exception requires explicit decision record citing the proof gap; cannot be justified by architectural appeal alone.

doctrine_freeze.strengthen_instead: Prefer raising confidence on existing principles and closing Burt proof steps over minting new principle IDs.

proof_packet.definition: A Proof Packet answers one proposition and, when finished, closes one gate or materially strengthens one claim/dossier.

three_layer_reviews_required_before_doct.name: Constitutional / legal evidence
questions: Could this exist within the Federal Constitution?

proof_packet.graduation_rule: Only after passing all three independent reviews may a Hypothesis Card graduate into publishable Constitutional Capitalism doctrine.
proof_packet.workflow_note: The three-layer retrofit (Burt step 2) is not a side checklist — it is the entire doctrine workflow for graduation.

biggest_risk.text: The biggest risk is not merely being wrong — it is building a beautiful internally consistent system that outsiders cannot believe because the evidentiary chain is not visible.
biggest_risk.audit_role: Forensic audit governance exists to prevent that failure mode.

hypothesis_cards.title: Community Prosperity Retirement Accounts
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Citizens can hold a fiduciary-capped local investment slice that aligns personal retirement security with community productive investment without imprudent concentration risk.
hypothesis_cards.note: Architecture surfaces may remain for capture; they are not manuscript-ready doctrine.

hypothesis_cards.title: Local Equity / Community Investment Units
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Resident-purchased or participation-earned Community Investment Units can finance productive local infrastructure with returns to citizen-owners under fiduciary boards.

hypothesis_cards.title: Family Business Continuity and Local Ownership Incentives
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Outcome-based incentives (Local Prosperity Scores, succession tools, patient capital) increase durable local wealth without punishing large firms or outside investment.

hypothesis_cards.title: Cooperative Capital and Cooperative Development Centers
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Practical cooperative development infrastructure raises worker/member ownership as a scalable option that recirculates value under transparent governance.
hypothesis_cards.note: NCEO ESOP and USDA ag-coop baselines are diagnosis context only — not a finished Proof Packet.

hypothesis_cards.title: Emergency Infrastructure as Prosperity Asset
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Treating fire/EMS/public health preparedness as prosperity infrastructure and rewarding measured resilience outcomes improves investment climate and household security.
evidence_needed: Legal authorities for reserves and mutual aid
hypothesis_cards.note: ISO PPC and NFPA volunteer baselines are diagnosis context only — not a finished Proof Packet.

hypothesis_cards.title: Local Food and Family Farm Wealth Engines
hypothesis_cards.proposition: Guaranteed institutional local markets, shared Food Utility infrastructure, and stewardship pay can make family farms engines of community wealth without micromanaging production.
evidence_needed: Food hub / mid-tier processing case studies
Counterarguments on cost, scale, and trade
hypothesis_cards.note: USDA ERS/FNS baselines are diagnosis context only. Proof Burden table and five packet scaffolds opened under CC-DEC-094 — not a graduated Proof Packet.

hypothesis_cards.title: Collaborative Constitutional Review
hypothesis_cards.proposition: After proof, legal, modeling, manuscript, and education maturity, a peer-review journal–style scholarly system (expertise-tagged reviewers, typed reviews, Impact Requests) can strengthen the document without crowdsourcing or social-media dynamics.
evidence_needed: Legal review of public comment liability
hypothesis_cards.note: PENULTIMATE LAYER (Phase 8). Peer-review journal model + Impact Requests under CC-DEC-098. Do not build in Phase 2. True capstone is HYP-118 Understand layer (Phase 9).

hypothesis_cards.title: Constitutional Capitalism Systems Intelligence Engine
hypothesis_cards.proposition: A RedDirt-connected whole-system impact engine can let users change inputs and see direct, indirect, delayed, distributional, and legal/tradeoff effects across the Constitutional Capitalism graph — with simulations labeled as scenario estimates and humans retaining all authority over doctrine and publication.
hypothesis_cards.note: TRUE CAPSTONE Phase 9. Architecture only. Does not raise modeling % until real models exist.

hypothesis_cards.title: Impact Requests → System Impact Review
hypothesis_cards.proposition: When a Phase 8 reviewer submits an Impact Request (e.g., change a policy variable), the Phase 9 Systems Intelligence Engine can return a structured System Impact Review — principles, claims, evidence packets, legal questions, variables, conflicts, simulation scenarios, and confidence — without accepting or rejecting the change.
evidence_needed: Human-in-the-loop approval before any doctrine change
Refusal rules when evidence is insufficient
hypothesis_cards.note: Bridge capability. Requires Phase 8 review platform + Phase 9 engine. Not built in Phase 2.

hypothesis_cards.title: Policy Diff Analysis
hypothesis_cards.proposition: A proposed manuscript or doctrine change can be analyzed as a framework-wide diff — counting and explaining affected doctrine items, principles, evidence packets, legal analyses, educational modules, and simulations — so unintended consequences are visible before acceptance.
evidence_needed: Graph edge completeness for doctrine↔claim↔source↔chapter links
Diff presentation UX without false precision
Human review gate before any accepted change
Explainability fields on every diff conclusion
hypothesis_cards.note: Phase 9 capability under roadmap freeze. Do not build in Phase 2.

website_node.role: Governing capture surface for Hypothesis Cards — not a public doctrine marketing page

do_not: Treat Architecture Candidate pages as publishable doctrine
Claim modeling or legal progress without actual work

derivation_test: New ideas must derive from the First Principle and Ten Foundational Axioms (CC-DEC-095) or remain Hypothesis Cards.

architecture_roadmap_freeze.rule: Architecture chapter closed. Default next work is proof. Architectural proposals must clear the CC-DEC-101 threshold gate.
threshold_questions: What deficiency in the current architecture does this solve?
Why can't the existing architecture accommodate it?
Which decisions would need to be revisited?
What new complexity does it introduce?
Does it strengthen or weaken Constitutional Symmetry?
